fields.jobDescription: The fellow will train alongside Ironvale's field maintenance crews, learning scheduled preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and safety procedures for utility-scale wind turbines.
responsibilities: Assist crews with scheduled preventive maintenance on turbine drivetrains
Document inspection findings in the maintenance tracking system
Support lockout/tagout procedures under direct supervision
Participate in daily safety briefings and toolbox talks
